scope: Local working-tree implementation; fake-model production-handler tests, not actual model or GUI verification
existing: Existing presentation, history, delivery controller, anchored block and package owners
proposed: Implemented minimal changes recorded in docs/Harness_Stability_Implementation_20261020.md; runtime adoption remains pending
doNotDuplicate: No new model call, permission gate, semantic judge, persistent state store or evaluation framework
invariants: Preserve original diagnostic capture and tool request/result pairs
Do not count hidden metadata as a delivered report
Retain shown block contents and commit only the selected input
validationPlan: Focused tests, existing complete suites, generated identity and portable extracted build
Actual model, GUI and performance checks remain adoption requirements

claims.claim: Injected metadata echoes are removed from prose and next-round messages, and metadata-only responses are not accepted as completed reports in tested normal and bounded paths.

evidence.observation: All chunk boundaries, CRLF, intentional literals, malformed data, stream/fallback/history consistency and original capture preservation are covered.
Production-handler tests cover metadata echoes on/off streaming, next tool round, and metadata-only normal/bounded report completion.

counterEvidence.observation: Non-injected or malformed data is deliberately preserved; this is not a universal log/security filter.

unknowns: Actual historical GUI ingress and host persistence are uncorrelated.
Real model behavior and deliberate unformatted raw-log reproduction are not exhaustively covered.

claims.claim: A newly created partial-projection summary reaches a same-anchor reasoning retry after the change while original read handles remain available.

evidence.observation: 72,000-character source result, deterministic pressure, note-enabled workspace and reasoning retry: before fix summary false/false; after fix false/true; handles retained both rounds.
Candidate does not mutate shown map; same-anchor A then B retains A and adds B; unchanged retry adds nothing; normal new-tool-round exact-prefix regression passes.

counterEvidence.observation: The partial body marker and archive read handle were already retained before the fix; source recovery was not lost.

unknowns: Same-anchor insertion can move the following suffix; actual server cache cost has not been measured.
A-to-B-to-A freshness, historical snapshot growth and project transitions are not solved by this minimal change.
